newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fangda shareholders vote for improved payout.
newsitem.headline: Fangda shareholders vote for improved payout.

text.p: Shenzhen Fangda Co Ltd's shareholders on Wednesday rejected the firm's plan to distribute two bonus shares for every 10 shares as the 1996 interim dividend, a company spokesman said.
Instead, shareholders voted in favour of a four-for-10 scrip payout, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

Shareholders agreed that the building materials producer was experiencing rapid development and its sharply expanded share capital would have little impact on earnings per share this year, the official said.
Fangda recently said its net profits rocketed 210.94 percent to 45.08 million yuan in the first half of 1996 from 14.50 million yuan in the same period of 1995, under Chinese accounting standards.
Under international accounting standards, Fangda said net earnings were 44.02 million yuan in the six months to June this year, but did not give a comparative figure.
